name: Universal Scabbard
body:
Price 2,000 gp; Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot none; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This plain steel scabbard functions as a masterwork combat scabbard. In addition, any melee weapon can be placed into this scabbard, transforming one end of it into a hilt as though it was a katana sized for a scabbard of this size.

When removed from the scabbard, the weapon regains its original shape. If this scabbard is destroyed, the weapon returns to its original shape.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells mending
